# Launching a new warehouse is a major milestone, but what makes me most proud is the incredible teamwork behind it. · 2026-08-11T00:00:00+00:00

Launching a new warehouse is a major milestone, but what makes me most proud is the incredible teamwork behind it.

Today, we celebrate the opening of ID Logistics in Rugby; a significant investment in our future, our customers, and our continued growth. Facilities and infrastructure are important, but the real success story is the people who made it happen.

Over just 11 weeks, colleagues from across the business have come together with a shared goal; rolling up their sleeves, supporting one another, and demonstrating the commitment, collaboration and determination that define our culture. From planning and preparation to execution, every team and every individual played a part in making this launch happen on schedule.

Seeing so many people step outside their day-to-day roles to support the project has been truly inspiring. It is a powerful reminder that when we work together as one team, we can achieve extraordinary things.

LPP Logistics is expanding its operational capabilities in South-Eastern Europe by launching a distribution centre near Bucharest. The warehouse, with a capacity of approximately 35 million items, has been designed with further expansion in mind and will support the growth of the Sinsay brand and the LPP Group’s operations in the region.

The investment strengthens LPP Logistics’ logistics infrastructure in South-East Europe. # LPP Logistics Opens New Warehouse near Bucharest 

30 July 2026

LPP Logistics, the company that provides logistics for the Reserved, Cropp, House, Mohito and Sinsay brands, is expanding its operational capacities in South-Eastern Europe by opening a distribution center near Bucharest.

The unit, with an area of ​​56,000 sqm, serves the LPP Group stores in Romania, Bulgaria and Greece. An additional advantage of the location is its proximity to the port of Constanta, which streamlines the organization of deliveries by sea.

The launch of the new center also marks the completion of the reconstruction of the logistics infrastructure following the fire that occurred at the warehouse last year.

“The launch of the new distribution center just one year after the decommissioning of the previous warehouse demonstrates the operational efficiency of LPP Logistics and the ability of our team to quickly rebuild the infrastructure essential for business continuity. # RJW Logistics Group Announces Major East Coast Hub in Hazleton, PA

RJW Logistics Group has officially announced a massive new fulfillment center in Hazleton, Pennsylvania—its first East Coast facility and a key milestone in the company’s national growth. The new 1 million+ square foot distribution center will bring over 350 new jobs to the Greater Hazleton area, while supporting RJW’s signature One-Inventory Strategy for more streamlined and sustainable retail supply chains. This move strengthens RJW’s logistics capabilities across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic regions, showcasing a deep commitment to innovation, environmental responsibility, and community development.

# Emiza Expands Bhiwandi Fulfilment Capacity by 2.32 Lakh Sq Ft

 11 Sep 2026 2 Min Read CW Team 

Emiza, a leading third-party logistics (3PL) provider, has expanded its Mumbai operations with the launch of two new fulfilment facilities in Bhiwandi, adding a combined capacity of 2.32 lakh sq ft to its network.

The new facilities, spread across 75,000 sq ft and 1,57,000 sq ft, mark Emiza’s fifth and sixth warehouses in the Mumbai region. The expansion strengthens the company’s fulfilment infrastructure in Western India amid the rapid growth of India’s digital commerce ecosystem.

With increasing online consumption, wider product categories and rising customer expectations for faster delivery, businesses are focusing on building efficient fulfilment networks. Emiza’s new facilities are designed to help brands position inventory closer to demand, manage higher order volumes and improve supply chain efficiency.

# Maersk Commits US$100m to New Hopedale Fulfillment Center, Advancing Integrated Logistics Push in the US Northeast

Maersk, the global integrator of container logistics operating across more than 130 countries, is deepening its footprint in North American contract logistics with a US$100m investment in a new fulfillment center in Hopedale, Massachusetts. The 617,000-square-foot facility is scheduled to open in late August 2026, positioning the company to strengthen fulfillment capacity for cargo owners across the region.

Built around the requirements of a single major e-commerce customer, the site will function as a central node in Maersk’s contract logistics network throughout the US Northeast. During peak periods, the center is engineered to process up to 330,000 units a day, a throughput enabled by advanced conveyor and sortation systems designed for high-volume, rapid-turnaround operations.

Dave Hune, Head of Maersk Contract Logistics North America, framed the commitment as a direct response to sustained customer demand for modern fulfillment
